column1: # The hand-written gates in scripts/ predate the gates/fixtures/<RULE-ID>/
# convention and take gate-specific flags (--diff, --repo, --index) that cannot
# be guessed from a directory layout. This table names, per gate, the exact
# command that MUST exit 1 and the exact command that MUST exit 0.
# A gate absent from this table and without a gates/fixtures/ directory is a
# violation — an unfixtured gate is an unproven one.
